nom: Burt's Bees Deep Cleansing Pore Scrub with Peach and Willow Bark

segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who names sensitive, allergy-prone skin reports the scrub rejuvenates and exfoliates her skin well without irritation, describing it as silkier and gentler than traditional apricot-pit scrubs.

concerns.blemishes: Reports are split at the extremes: one reviewer says her acne was already clearing up after just a week of use, while another had a severe reaction, breaking out badly with wounds around her eyebrows, and recommends against using it on the face at all, though she says it's fine on the body.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the scrub cleans without over-drying the skin, leaving a moisturized feeling and a soft glow rather than tightness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers, including one who is allergic to many products, report no irritation from this scrub; the one reviewer who had a bad reaction describes it in terms of breakouts and wounds rather than redness specifically.

aspects.libelle: Multi-packs sometimes arrive with fewer tubes than labeled
Bottles can appear only half full
Gentle, fine-grain texture, silkier than apricot-pit scrubs
Priced higher on Amazon than in some stores
Wish the ingredient list were fully clean or natural

extraits.texte: Made me break out really bad. I developed wounds in my eyebrows. Wouldnt recommend for use on face. Body use is fine.
